newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end at record high in record volume.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end at record high in record volume.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed at new highs in record volume on Friday with the Ibex futures contract expiry boosting trade even further.
The general index added 5.15 points, 1.22 percent, to 428.57 and the Ibex rose 57.90 points, 1.18 percent, to 4,966.75 after coming off key resistance at 5,000 mid-afternoon.
Repsol added 95 pesetas to 4,950, with interest provoked by its underperformance versus other key stocks, dealers said.
Telefonica closed down 10 pesetas to 2,995. No placement calendar for next year's share offer was given at today's cabinet meeting.
Dealers said the movement in Madrid was fully justified by gains in New York but the surprising element was volume, which continues to be constituted by domestic funds taking positions.
"There's no paper, so buy baskets simply shoot the market higher. But it's pretty amazing really," said one dealer.
Turnover totalled an unprecedented level of 121 billion pesetas, with the market expected to slow down next week ahead of the Christmas break.
